_comment: Which images the scene uses and where things sit inside them. Fractions are of the window inside each image (the transparent shadow margin and popover arrow are cropped automatically): u from the left, v from the top. Files are looked up in Promo/<shots_dir> first, then Promo/textures (drawn mock-ups). "auto" values are measured from each language's own capture when the scene is built.

key._comment: How opaque each flat UI background stays as a veil over the glass: [main area, sidebar]. The rest of the background is keyed out and the content's anti-aliased edges are un-mixed from it.

chat_timeline._reveal_steps_v: auto: a stop under each row of content, so rows appear whole

chat_permission._permission_rect: left in the panel when the prompt lifts out: the prompt box and its header
chat_permission._lift_rect: auto: the prompt box just inside its border, cut a little right of its longest line in this language

terminal._hide_rect: the approximate-terminal footer ('Connect to Orca…') is masked so it reads as the live terminal
terminal._typed: the same terminal with the command typed at the prompt; the typed glyphs, caret and field are measured from the difference

chat_question._typed: the same view with the reply typed into the composer and the send button shown

terminal_after._hide_rect: the approximate-terminal footer ('Connect to Orca…') is masked so it reads as the live terminal
terminal_after._scroll_from: scrolls up into place from that face's typed capture; the rows under the submitted prompt appear one by one
